description: Child and teen BMI percentile and z-score from WHO growth references (0-19 y, default) or CDC charts (2-20 y), with the weight category and healthy BMI range. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.
